title: Configure doesn't update search state with new props
body:
**Bug: What is the current behavior?**
Changing props on configure does not update search state. In past issues, I was talking about how on mount the state is off, now it seems changing the props passed does not update the state. See the video example: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2NXGUqTAEpQ\&feature=youtu.be

**What project are you opening an issue for?**

* react-instantsearch
